paragraphs.text: Sharpwing is a bird ally from Zendikar .

Sharpwing is a young bird of prey from around the Umara River that is often brought on expeditions. Unlike other animals brought on expeditions, rather than being treated as a beast of burden, beast or war, or familiar to a wizard or ranger , she is often treated as a full-fledged member of the party. She is famous for being a ferocious huntress, meticulous messenger, and vigilant scout. Due to these traits she has often been requested for some of the most dangerous expeditions that have occurred in her lifetime. She is a brown feathered raptor with a white underside that has a wingspan around the size of an adult human arm.
